description: The all-in variable rate today for a loan priced at an index plus a margin, such as an SBA 7(a) loan at prime + 2.75, a business line of credit at prime + 1 or a commercial loan at 30-day average SOFR + 2.5, with an optional floor or cap and the monthly payment for an amount and term.

amount.description: Loan amount in dollars, for a monthly payment.

cap_percent.description: Rate cap in percent, if the loan has one.

floor_percent.description: Rate floor in percent, if the loan has one.

index.description: The rate index the loan is priced on.

margin_percent.description: Percentage points over the index, e.g. 2.75.

name: loan_rate_calculator
title: Prime or SOFR plus margin loan rate
